relations: Glowing embers and burning logs supply heat, sustaining upward flame tongues anchored at the log base.
Rising hot gases deform the flame envelope, causing tongues to merge, split, and shift height frame to frame.
Intermittent upward motion detaches small flame fragments briefly above the main body.
Fixed camera and dark tree silhouettes remain static while only the fire visibly changes shape.
caption: The video captures a fire burning on a horizontal log structure against a dark outdoor background, with silhouetted trees and an angled fallen trunk on the right. Bright orange-yellow flames occupy the center, anchored at the log base, while a glowing ember bed persists beneath the front log. The flames continuously deform and flicker, with tongues of fire rising, merging, splitting, and shifting in height and shape from frame to frame. The overall flame envelope alternates between taller, narrower columns and shorter, broader bursts, without a single monotonic trend. Small detached flame fragments occasionally appear briefly above the main flame body, suggesting intermittent upward flame motion. The camera viewpoint and background elements appear fixed, with the visible motion dominated by flame deformation.
